title: Notice to Vacate and the Move-Out Share of an Estimated Water Read — Utility Pass-Through Service Definitions
content:
**Move-out share.** For an estimated water read on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, where the Home-Site Lease the account serves carries a notice to vacate whose vacate date is no more than 30 days after the handling date, the estimate is set at 85 percent, and where that vacate date is more than 30 days after the handling date, the estimate is set at 95 percent; a lease carrying no notice to vacate takes no move-out share in the estimate.

## Definitions

- **Lease carrying a notice to vacate**: the Home-Site Lease the account serves shows the status notice to vacate, with the vacate date stated in that notice.
- **Days to the vacate date**: the vacate date less the handling date, in days.
- **No more than 30 days**: 30 days or fewer. **More than 30 days**: 31 days or more.
- **Effect**: the share multiplies the estimated consumption as converted to the cycle, before the final figure is rounded.

## Reading the definition (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Home-Site Lease status | Vacate date | Days after the handling date | Estimate set at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notice to vacate | 30 June | 20 | 85 percent |
| Notice to vacate | 10 July | 30 | 85 percent |
| Notice to vacate | 11 July | 31 | 95 percent |
| Active, no notice to vacate | none | — | no move-out share |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Converted figure 4.40 kgal, vacate date 20 days away: 4.40 times 85 percent is 3.74 kgal.
